knowledge_units.context_summary: ProNetView-ccRCC is an interactive web-based portal designed to visualize and explore the clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) phosphopeptide co-expression network derived from CPTAC data. The tool allows users to interact with a network of 3,614 genes and 30 functional modules, querying associations between phosphopeptide abundance and clinical variables such as tumor grade.

attributes.purpose: investigating phosphopeptide co-expression network inferred based on CPTAC clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) phosphoproteomics data

relationships.target: abundance of each phosphopeptide and clinical variables such as tumor grade

attributes.source_data: CPTAC clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) phosphoproteomics data

attributes.full_name: National Cancer Institute's Clinical Proteomics Tumor Analysis Consortium
attributes.activity: performing comprehensive large-scale proteogenomic characterizations of multiple cancer types

relationships.target: breast, colon, ovarian, and kidney cancer patients

attributes.function: serve as useful tools to gain system-level understanding of molecular regulatory factories underlying diseases

relationships.target: complicated pathway interactions and dysfunctions that drive tumor initiation and progression

knowledge_units.context_summary: ProNetView-ccRCC is an open-access web portal for interactive 3D exploration of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) phosphopeptide co-expression networks. The tool visualizes a network of 20,976 phosphopeptides and 30 functional modules derived from CPTAC data using a random-forest algorithm and Glay clustering. It allows users to query genes, pathways, and clinical variables such as tumor grade and stage.

attributes.browser_compatibility: runs on all modern web browsers without additional plug-ins

attributes.connection_rule: two genes connected if at least two phosphopeptides mapping to them are associated

attributes.derivation_method: Glay clustering algorithm based on overall network topology
attributes.metadata: pathway enrichment analysis via Fisher Exact test

attributes.focus: clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) phosphoproteomics

attributes.purpose: stereoscopic and immersive exploration of networks

knowledge_units.context_summary: The text describes the interactive features of the ProNetView-ccRCC portal, specifically demonstrating how users can query genes like ERG and explore module networks. It details the visualization of gene connections, metadata such as tumor grade associations, and the ability to filter genes based on phenotype and FDR cutoffs.

relationships.target: list of genes directly connected to ERG
association of ERG phosphoprotein with tumor grade

attributes.function: web-based interface to explore ccRCC multi-omics data through interactive heatmaps

knowledge_units.context_summary: ProNetView-ccRCC is a free, open-access web tool for exploring CPTAC clear cell renal cell carcinoma networks. It operates in modern web browsers without requiring specific plugins or libraries. The tool is designed to help researchers of varying computational skill levels analyze and share results from CPTAC ccRCC network data.

attributes.dependency_requirement: no specific plugins or libraries required
